decisions.reason: As a recent extension close to the firm's municipal and fluid-handling fabrication capabilities, it is likely to stay while management gives it more time to prove itself against aspiration levels.
Public waste bins are relatively distant from the firm's core offer, so if early results are only mediocre management is likely to reallocate resources to closer products and development projects.
This product line fits the firm's metalworking skills and public-sector customer base well, making it likely to be retained while sales information is still emerging.
Although related to the new ground-sleeve line, the cast-iron variant is less aligned with the firm's stated steel and stainless expertise and is more likely to fall below aspiration levels.
Steel ground sleeves closely match the firm's material capabilities and can be supported with little additional search, so management would likely keep them on the market.
